name: pronated-90-degree-band-pull-apart
instructions:
1. Set up in an athletic position with a band in both hands and your palms facing down.
2. Pin the elbows to your sides at 90 degrees
3. Exhale and externally rotate the shoulders by pull the band apart slightly
4. Slowly rotate back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
